title: Een klein heldendicht
summary: "Een klein heldendicht" by Herman Gorter is a poem published in 1906. The work traces the awakening of socialist consciousness in two young Catholic workers—Willem, a metalworker, and Maria, a weaver. Through nine cantos, they encounter strikes, union meetings, and influential socialist speakers. As they grapple with concepts of class struggle and Marx's theories, their political understanding deepens.
